name: thermostat
description: Shows when your prompt cache goes cold, and stops the expensive send.

guard.title: Cold-send guard
guard.description: hold: stop the first prompt sent on a cold cache once and show what it costs. warn: show the cost and send. off: do nothing.

cacheMinutes.title: Cache window (minutes)
cacheMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after the last request, used until Claude Code reports its own window. 0 works it out from your login: 60 on a subscription, 5 on an API key.
